# Project Context

## Active task: 压缩流式与 Sources 核验

The user requests a tightly scoped, read-only research delegation and a Chinese analysis of official documentation as it applies to long conversations with streamed content.

### Delegation and workflow
- Delegate to exactly one read-only researcher; do not call any other members.
- The researcher must use `webfetch` to actually read the body text of each of the three official pages listed below.
- The researcher must write the full Chinese analysis directly in their own normal, visible messages. Keep all research results in normal visible messages, not separate artifacts.
- The lead must directly verify the returned analysis and the page-reading records, then close out the task.

### Allowed sources
Read only these three pages; cite the pages actually read:
1. MDN, `ResizeObserver`: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/ResizeObserver
2. MDN, CSS `pointer-events`: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/pointer-events
3. W3C, WCAG 2.2 Understanding Focus Order: https://www.w3.org/WAI/WCAG22/Understanding/focus-order.html

### Required analysis
- Write in Chinese, with 18 subsections and approximately 6,000 Chinese characters.
- Every subsection must contain at least two paragraphs.
- Explain the applicability and limitations of these documents in relation to streamed body content in long conversations, source reading, users scrolling upward, layout changes, and keyboard focus.
- Include one comparison table and two short code examples.
- Explicitly distinguish documented facts from design recommendations.

### Restrictions
- Do not search for supplementary sources or read any pages beyond the three specified.
- Do not read local files or credentials.
- Do not create or modify files, or publish additional artifacts.

### Current state
Only the task request is recorded. No delegation, page reads, research output, verification, or completion is evidenced yet.

# Project Memory

The only recorded user request is to reply with `OK`. No substantive project goals, decisions, work state, attachments, or unresolved risks have been established.
